description: Admins only. Your account starts as a company named after you. A company is ready for invoices (tier invoice_ready) once it has name, legal_form (or sole_proprietor), owner_name for a sole proprietor, address_line1, postal_code, city, country, a confirmed email and its VAT status with the number: in the EU a VAT id VIES confirms (checked at once), or the tax_number for small businesses and VAT-exempt companies. Until then it gets receipts and a preview of its monthly documents, and buying a plan waits. Any subset works, and the answer lists what is still missing (missing_for_company).

address_line1.description: Street and number of the registered address

address_line2.description: Optional second line of the address

address_state.description: State or province, written after the city in the USA, Canada and Australia (TX, ON, NSW)

currency.description: The currency amounts are shown in, next to USDC: EUR (default, the currency of the documents), USD, or any currency with an ECB reference rate

email.description: Where documents and notices go. A code confirms it

fx_method.description: How USDC becomes EUR on documents. Today only ecb_daily (ECB reference rate of the payment day)

language.description: Language of documents and mails: en, de, fr, it, es, nl, pt, sv, da, fi or nb. Null takes the language of the country

name.description: Legal name of the company, without the legal form

own_accounts.description: With skr OWN: the expense, clearing and USDC holding accounts of your chart, 4 to 8 digits, and optionally gift_cards for gift card purchases (the expense account otherwise)

owner_name.description: A sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen, e.K., sole trader ...): the first and last name of the owner. It stands on every document, never in the register or on a listing. Empty removes it

postal_code.description: Postal code of the registered address

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

skr.description: Chart of accounts for exports. OWN takes own_accounts

sole_proprietor.description: True for one person without a legal form of its own where the country has none to choose. Then owner_name is required

tax_number.description: The national tax number, for vat_status tax_number or where the country asks for it

vat_id.description: VAT id in the format of its country, like DE123456789 or ATU12345678 (GET /v1/countries). EU numbers are checked against VIES

vat_status.description: How the company stands with VAT: vat_id, tax_number (registered, VAT id still to come), small_business (§ 19 UStG) exempt (only VAT-exempt sales) or not_registered (no VAT registration, the USA or another country without VAT). Decides the tax note on its documents

name: company.update
title: Fill in or change the company data
